issue.title: [DocDB] Add limit for temporary memory used by  xCluster reading WALs

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-17943](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-17943)
### Description

Currently we have no tracking of the memory holding WAL records read from disk.  (The code that reads these records and allocates the memory is in LogCache.)

This can lead to a TServer crashing due to running out of memory -- see [#22992: DocDB Xcluster node becomes unreachable due to OOM.](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/22992).

This task is to fix this problem by adding a memory tracker for this memory as well as a limit that prevents it from growing so large that it causes the TServer to run out of memory.

kind/bug
